title: Corgi Races at The Jackalope South Shore
location: The Jackalope South Shore, 1523 Tinnin Ford Rd.
description: Corgi races, coney dogs, puppy pools, DIY tie-dyed bandanas, pup cups, yappy hour, and local vendors at The Jackalope South Shore. Free to watch.

title: Texas Football vs. Texas State
description: Texas Football kicks off the 2026 season at home against Texas State at DKR–Texas Memorial Stadium.

title: Canopy Open Studios
description: Explore dozens of private art studios open to the public with a live DJ, local vendor pop-ups, and food pop-ups. Family and pet friendly.

title: San Marcos Block Party
description: Labor Day Weekend celebration of music and art featuring Tape B, Juicy J, Waka Flocka, art installations, food vendors, and more.

title: Austin Bat Fest 2026
location: Congress Avenue Bridge, 100 S. Congress Ave, Austin, TX
description: Experience 1.5 million bats taking flight at the 20th anniversary of Austin Bat Fest, featuring live music, food vendors, arts and crafts, and family activities on the Congress Avenue Bridge.

title: Save Big Bend Rally
description: Weekly protest supporting Save Big Bend against wall construction. Bring water, sunscreen, and signs.

title: ThrillerCon Austin
description: ThrillerCon comes to Palmer Events Center featuring 100+ vendors with vintage clothes, sneakers, streetwear, trading cards, accessories, and a famous $20 Fill-a-Bag sale.

title: Sinner's Brunch Two-Stepping at Jo's Coffee
description: Jo's Coffee hosts Sinner's Brunch with live music from the house band and open two-stepping. Free, all ages, and beginner-friendly with no partner required.

title: Ben & Lynn's Grand Opening
description: Ben & Lynn's by chef Joshua Weissman opens on the east side on Saturday, September 12, featuring fried chicken sandwiches, soft serve, local beers, and more.

title: Pecan Street Festival
description: Pecan Street Festival returns with live music, local artists, food vendors, and family fun at Hill Country Galleria.

title: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015...
description: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015 This happens to be our 9,000th post (hell ya) From our founder @champagnecates: Our first post ever was SLAB BBQ’s 1 year anniversary with $1 drinks and $1 sandwiches. After 11 years I can honestly say that WWW has the same heart, same ethos, same community-driven mentality from day one. I set out to change the way event-goer and event were connected. I wanted to combine my writing background and my partying background to deliver plans and news in a minimal and personable new way. I feel like we really did all that.
